attacks.name: Gun
attacks.description: Fire your shotgun in bursts of two.

teamUpAbilities.name: Comical Chaos
teamUpAbilities.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

abilities.name: Breathing Gunshot
abilities.description: Fire a splintering gunshot that ricochets off surfaces towards nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Gun Launch
abilities.description: Dash ahead, then launch yourself and a target with a special gunshot. Press again while airborne to launch again.

abilities.name: Trap
abilities.description: Lay out a trap monster that snares an enemy. Once activated, press again to dash towards it.

passives.name: Instinct
passives.description: [blue]Instinct[/blue] reduces ability cooldowns. [blue]Instinct [/blue]is built after getting eliminations.

passives.name: Elephant Gun
passives.description: After using a movement ability, load your elephant gun for an empowered, piercing attack.

ultimate.name: Dinnertime
ultimate.description: Release the Glartrox, who charges at enemies straight ahead. Press again to recall.
